description:
With their parents suddenly deciding to live in the countryside, Daeyoung, who went down to the countryside with his elder brother, Daesu, met the sons of their dad's friend, Sunghyeon and Gangjin.
"Daesu's brother is the spare."
"Okay, let him be the goal keeper."
When he was younger, he could still stand alongside his elder brothers as a spare.
A three years age gap was nothing, but the distance between them grew.
Then, one day.
Hearing that the elder brothers were hanging out, Daeyoung secretly joined and went to Sunghyeon's house together, but—
"Ah, bastards. Why the hell are you sneaking in at this time?"
"I came because I was wondering what you were doing. You weren't answering me."
"Fucking annoying. Why did you barge in without telling. Are you brain-dead?"
"What?"
I came to know the "true" side of Sunghyeon who was always kind to me.
[To: Stuckup Scholar
If I find your hideout, I'll let you know!
From: Cute Daeyoung]
Thinking that he had been fooled this entire time, he decided on a cute(?) revenge!
